intro: Tapo C211 hood, draft 1 (clip-on, two halves). The white camera, glass, frame and bracket are rough stand-ins; the dark hood halves are the draft. Measure each arrow in mm (calipers or a ruler) and type it in; leave a box empty if you can't reach it. Also tell me, in the notes or in chat: (a) does the camera turn or nod by itself when it powers up? (b) how it attaches to the bracket now: screw, twist-lock plate or adhesive, and the hole spacing if it's screws; (c) does the base have a lip, groove or step a clip could grab, or is its side smooth? (d) your foam tape thickness, width and whether it's sticky on both sides.

measurements.label: Base diameter
measurements.how: Calipers across the round base that stays still (the part against the bracket).

measurements.label: Base height
measurements.how: From the bracket face down to where the base ends and the turning body starts.

measurements.label: Widest turning part
measurements.how: Widest point of the body/ball below the base, any direction.

measurements.label: Total height
measurements.how: Bracket face down to the lowest point of the ball.

measurements.label: Lens centre height
measurements.how: Bracket face down to the centre of the lens, with the camera aimed where you want it.

measurements.label: Lens to glass
measurements.how: Front of the lens straight out to the glass.

measurements.label: Visible glass width
measurements.how: Glass edge to glass edge, at the camera's height.

measurements.label: Camera to right glass edge
measurements.how: From straight under the camera's centre sideways to where the glass meets the right frame.

measurements.label: Frame face out from glass
measurements.how: How far the right frame strip's face stands out from the glass.

measurements.label: Cable plug height
measurements.how: Bracket face down to the centre of the cable plug; also note which way it points (glass, room, left, right).
